A conceptual rebranding proposal for the 6th National Youth Design Awards (NYDA).

Overview

SILPACHEEP is a Thai arts and crafts initiative established under the royal initiative of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, the Queen Mother, to preserve traditional craftsmanship and create sustainable livelihoods for local artisans.

Developed as part of the 6th National Youth Design Awards (NYDA), this rebranding project aims to reinterpret SILPACHEEP’s visual identity through three key concepts
Artistic, Contemporary and Valuable, connecting Thailand’s cultural heritage with modern audiences and bringing Thai craftsmanship to an international stage.

Logo Design

The logo concept draws inspiration from the essence of SILPACHEEP, where traditional craftsmanship becomes a foundation for sustainable livelihoods.
Through three core principles — Elegance, Stability, and Connection — the design translates the initiative’s values into a contemporary typographic identity, balancing the delicacy of craftsmanship with the strength of community empowerment.

Visual Identity & Applications

A flexible and adaptable layout system was developed to maintain visual consistency across various communication platforms. The system allows design elements to be easily rearranged and applied to different formats, particularly social media content, while preserving the brand’s visual identity.

Designer : Ammily Prain
